turns.content: Plan a synthesis of 2-(tert-butyl)-1-ethoxy-3-nitrobenzene from benzene. The ether will be formed from the corresponding phenol, and the route must respect both amine-AlCl3 incompatibility and the use of a temporary sulfonic-acid blocking group.
Which prerequisite transformation should be performed first? Justify the order using the amine-AlCl3 compatibility constraint in the proposed route.

Using the ordering chosen above, explain how the temporary blocking group controls the first substitution and how the subsequent functional-group interconversions prepare oxygen installation and the later substitution.
Explain how oxygen installation, removal of the sulfonic-acid blocking group, and ether formation must be ordered on this aromatic intermediate.
Assemble the complete reagent sequence from benzene, using the directing effects, temporary blocking group, and functional-group prerequisites already identified.
Apply the previously selected oxygen-installation method to the intermediate reached above before forming the ether.
State the complete ordered synthesis and explain the purpose of each step.
Describe this as the best-supported sequence under the stated constraints, and identify any yield, stoichiometry, or regioisomer information that remains unspecified.
Check that the directing effects, functional-group prerequisites, blocking-group removal, oxygen installation, and ether-forming reaction are mutually compatible in the proposed sequence.
Report the complete final synthesis and summarize the chemical role of each step.
